text: v1.0.140 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.140 (grading for bets like UTA +11.5; profit = winnings incl. returned stakes minus cost, per day and all time). Fixed on the engine (it now uses every priced side, no limits or margins changed) and restarted the engine. I'll check next whether the share we can price goes up.
